proposed.text: A building owner converts a former barangay health center into a dental clinic without filing any application with the Building Official. Under PD 1096, which statement is MOST accurate?

options.text: The conversion is valid because a dental clinic is less hazardous than a health center, and thus poses no increased risk
The conversion violates Sec. 702 — any change in occupancy group or division requires Building Official approval regardless of relative hazard
The conversion is valid because both uses are health-related, and therefore fall under the same general category
The owner only needs to update the signage to reflect the new use, as long as no structural changes are made

proposed.rationale: Option A misapplies the less hazardous pathway — even if less hazardous, approval is still required. Option C incorrectly assumes same-function uses are in the same occupancy group — health-related uses can be in different groups. Option D trivializes the requirement to a signage change. The Building Official may order cessation of operations for unapproved changes.
